Write the whole-module specification

Read input: origen_163553.v · Open raw
module origen_163553(
    input [31:0] src1,
    input [31:0] src2,
    input less,
    input A_invert,
    input B_invert,
    input cin,
    input [1:0] operation,
    output reg [31:0] result,
    output reg cout
);

    wire [31:0] src1_inverted = A_invert ? ~src1 : src1;
    wire [31:0] src2_inverted = B_invert ? ~src2 : src2;
    reg [31:0] temp_result;
    reg temp_cout;

    always @(*) begin
        case (operation)
            2'b00: begin
                // Bitwise AND
                temp_result = src1_inverted & src2_inverted;
                temp_cout = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b01: begin
                // Bitwise OR
                temp_result = src1_inverted | src2_inverted;
                temp_cout = 1'b0;
            end
            2'b10: begin
                // Bitwise XOR
                {temp_cout, temp_result} = {1'b0, src1_inverted ^ src2_inverted} + cin;
            end
            2'b11: begin
                // Set less than
                temp_result = {31'b0, less};
                temp_cout = less;
            end
            default: begin
                temp_result = 32'b0;
                temp_cout = 1'b0;
            end
        endcase
    end

    // Assign the intermediate results to the output ports
    always @(*) begin
        result = temp_result;
        cout = temp_cout;
    end

endmodule
